# ankra_provenance_policy (Resource)

The organisation's default deploy provenance mode (`ankra org provenance set`), which applications follow when they choose none: `off`, `warn` (deploy and file a finding for an image without verified provenance) or `enforce` (refuse such a deploy). There is one per organisation; an application's own mode (`ankra application provenance set`) overrides it. Signing key rotation and revocation stay imperative (`ankra org provenance rotate`, `revoke`). Setting the mode needs `security.manage`. Destroy leaves the mode as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_provenance_policy" "default" {
  mode = "enforce"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `off`, `warn` or `enforce`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `provenance_policy`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one per organisation; any id imports it.
terraform import ankra_provenance_policy.default provenance_policy
```
